persons.name: Antiphates
persons.role: Leader or representative of a group of settlers

rationale: This is a significant legal document from the early 5th century BC, often referred to as the 'Statute of Naupaktos'. It details the conditions under which Hypocnemidian Lokrians could settle in Naupaktos, covering citizenship, religious participation, taxation, and the legal status of property and inheritance. The text is remarkably well-preserved on a bronze tablet and provides deep insight into Greek colonial law and the relationship between a metropolis and its colony.
